name: Rajesh Kumar
quote: Sanuma's team completely digitized our assembly floor tracking. The OPC-UA telemetry system they deployed has given us unprecedented visibility into bottleneck cycles, improving our line throughput by 14%.

name: Ananya Sharma
quote: Our legacy databases were highly siloed. Sanuma built a secure, centralized cloud portal that connects our warehousing operations with our finance pipelines. Their code is exceptionally clean.

name: David Miller
quote: The predictive maintenance algorithms they implemented on our rotary fans saved us from a major unscheduled outage. We received a thermal overload alert 48 hours before physical failure occurred.
